_readme: Controls the SHAPE of the eLabFTW JSON written by 'Export to eLabFTW': group ids,
group names, and the text used in field names. This is NOT the file that decides
which fields the export dialog offers - that is elabftw_bol_procedures.json.
Delete any key to fall back to its default (shown below as the shipped value) -
you only need to list the keys you actually want to change.
Every '{...}' placeholder must be kept literally in the strings that use it, or
the fallback below is used instead and a note is printed to the console.
group ids: eLabFTW treats id 0 as 'no group', so keep every id in this file, and
every id implied by the two '_base' values below (base + Pol 1..6), away from 0.
_readme_naming: Field names here must match the ones the PEMFC MEA Test Procedure Builder writes,
so a procedure export and a results export of the same run can be loaded into one
eLabFTW entry and line up field for field. Two rules come out of that:
1. Empty bol_field_prefix / ast_field_prefix mean 'reuse the field name the
procedure file already used' (e.g. 'BOL: Galvanostatic Ramp (GSTEP): Temperature')
rather than inventing a shorter one ('BOL Temperature') that nothing can match.
2. Pol N exports as EC N. The builder numbers blocks EC(conditionId + catalogSize x
phaseIndex) - the same arithmetic as the bench's SetMarker - so Pol 4 is the
post-AST measurement of condition 1, and is called EC4 in both tools.
_readme_pol_ids: Pol N's group id = base + N, e.g. base 0 -> Pol 1..6 use ids 1..6.
_readme_patterns: {pol} is the Pol number (1..6); {pol_export_label} is the result of applying
_readme_no_scope_word: Field names carry no scope word ('Polarization Curve:', 'Conditions:'): the group
heading already says which block and which section, so repeating it only made the
rows longer. What remains is the block number - required, because extra_fields is one
flat map and 'i @ 0.6 V [A/cm²]' alone would collide between blocks - and the quantity.
_readme_result_metric_labels: Exported label per result metric - the text after 'EC4 ' in the field name. These
must match the blank result fields the Procedure Builder puts in its Key Results
group, or a measured value creates a new field instead of filling the one waiting
for it. The keys on the left (i06/i065/ocv/pmax) are fixed internal ids, do not
rename them; only retype the label text on the right.
The unit appears here in the name AND in result_metric_units below. That is
deliberate: flat reports and CSV exports keep only the value, so a name without a
unit leaves a column of bare numbers.
_readme_result_metric_units: Written to eLabFTW's own 'unit'/'units' properties, so the number stays
machine-readable. Set one to "" to omit it.
_readme_filename: {key} is replaced with the dataset's Key (folder/archive name).
